notes.title: Policy Update - New Content
notes.notes:
Hey employees,



We have updated our policy effective immediately to grant workers access to a new level in the facility. Just a reminder, [The Company] is not responsible for any injuries caused while on and off the clock.



Here is the run down on this new policy

New level: [spoiler]Go into Café VOID and discover some weird organic shit... and perhaps Cynthia?[/spoiler]

Exploration mode: Explore the levels without worrying about the energy count

Dualsense bug fixes

New Community Items


Community Items
We have done an in house study and learned that rewards boost morale and work productivity.


With the results of that study, we used the planned raises we were going to give you to release Steam trading cards, badges, backgrounds, and emoticons. Remember that [The Company] always has your thoughts and feelings in mind when making decisions.



If you already explored the facility, you may notice some Steam cards already in your inventory. [The Company] has allocated 5 minutes of unpaid time for co-workers to trade to collect all 5 Steam cards.
